signals.text: When any member of staff has concerns about a pupil, they raise them with the Class Teacher, SEND teacher, member of the Leadership Team or Deputy Headteacher for Inclusion (DHT), who offer support and advice.
● Where needed, individual plans (Pupil Inclusion Plans), which employ a small -step target approach, are implemented to support pupils and monitor progress.

This will enable us to develop the music curriculum further, developing additional provision of targeted clubs and interventions for pupils with SEND, as well as pupils who are extending their learning and achievement beyond age related expectations.

pageCache.pageTitle: Hounslow Heath School - Welcome from the Headteacher
pageCache.text:
Hounslow Heath School | Martindale Rd, Hounslow, Middlesex, TW4 7HE
Welcome from the Headteacher
Welcome to our school website. I hope it gives you an insight into our school.
Hounslow Heath School is an inclusive school and we pride ourselves on how we nurture pupils to flourish and achieve the best outcomes. We also support our pupils in developing confidence and resilience in order to prepare them for the next phases of their schooling and as citizens of the future. We foster a love of learning through our exciting, engaging and ambitious curriculum which covers all aspects of the Early Years Foundation Stage and National Curriculum.
Our school motto is 'Soaring to Excellence'. Through our high-quality teaching, we maintain high standards of achievement and behaviour. We are committed to working in partnership with our parents and wider community in order that our pupils thrive in all aspects of their learning. We provide a vibrant indoor and outdoor learning environment which is stimulating and supports our curriculum aims.

Hounslow Heath School | Martindale Rd, Hounslow, Middlesex, TW4 7HE
Breakfast and Afterschool Club
OHM is a local award winning company who provide holiday camps, wrap around care & sports coaching in schools in the local community. We are focused on providing high quality, enriching activities to enhance the lives of children from a young age. All of our staff hold enhanced DBS checks, are first aid trained and passionate about the service that they provide.
Come & Join us for a morning or afternoon of fun!
We will have a jam-packed programme of before and after school activities for your child to take part in such as Sports & Games, Arts & Crafts, Forest school sessions, Mindfulness activities & much more!
Our Early Bird sessions will start your child off to a great day and they will receive a nutritious breakfast and take part in our planned activities. This runs from 7.30am-9am daily.
Our Evening Owls Club runs in 2 sessions from 3.15pm-4.30pm or from 3.15pm-6pm. If your child is already in an after school club you also have the option to just book on for the later session from 4.30pm-6pm.
Children will receive a snack in our Evening Owls 1 Session and a light meal in our Evening Owls 2 session.
To book your child's space please visit or website below.
If you need any help feel free to contact us on 02033028554 or ohmadmin@ohmcoaching.co.uk.
Aims of Wraparound Childcare
Our wraparound childcare aims to provide a safe, nurturing, and stimulating environment for children before and after the school day, ensuring that every child has the opportunity to learn, play, and grow. We want our provision to support not only children’s development but also families’ needs for reliable, affordable, and high-quality childcare.
What Children and Families Will Gain
For children: engaging activities that promote social skills, creativity, independence, and wellbeing. Opportunities to take part in enrichment activities that complement the school day, including sports, arts, and play-based learning.For families: peace of mind that their children are cared for in a safe, inclusive setting. Flexible, affordable childcare that fits around work and family life. Clear information about financial support options available for childcare costs.Meeting Diverse Needs
Our vision is to create an inclusive and accessible provision where all children can thrive.
Our wraparound childcare complements and extends the wider school provision:

Hounslow Heath School | Martindale Rd, Hounslow, Middlesex, TW4 7HE
Volunteers at Hounslow Heath School
Hounslow Heath School aims to engage parents and carers fully in the children͛'s learning and development, in line with the schools aims and values of the school in order to ‘soar to excellence’. The school and Governing Body also aim to develop engagement across the school and wider community. In order to enrich the lives of the children in school, and to enable us to deliver the curriculum more effectively, we actively encourage the involvement of parents and volunteers from the community in the work of the school.
Anyone wishing to become a volunteer, either for individual events should contact the school office in order to communicate with the appropriate coordinator or lead. Any potential volunteers for trips and offsite activities need to communicate with class teachers and trip leaders.
The Volunteer Policy for procedures and expectations at Hounslow Heath School is being reviewed and will be made available below, when this review has been completed.

Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND) and Centres
At Hounslow Heath School, we are proud to offer a fully inclusive community where all children are equally valued.
Through high quality classroom teaching, a holistic approach and high expectations, we prepare our children to be successful independent learners. We recognise that some children will require additional support to achieve this and that working in partnership with families is key to ensuring the best possible outcomes for our children.
Hounslow Heath School has two specialist SEND Centres on behalf of the London Borough of Hounslow; one for pupils with physical disabilities and one for pupils with moderate learning difficulties.
Click on the link below to meet the SEND Team, and the Local Offer for SEND at Hounslow Heath School:
